check_trf005_violations: check a Python AST tree for TRF005 violations where _no_split_modules is not a list or tuple of non-empty strings
test_no_split_modules_validation: test that _no_split_modules in a model class is a list or tuple containing only non-empty strings
refactor_no_split_modules: refactor a model class to set _no_split_modules as a list of non-empty string module names
review_model_no_split_modules: review pretrained model classes to ensure _no_split_modules is properly defined as a list of non-empty strings
summarize_trf005_rule: summarize the TRF005 lint rule that enforces _no_split_modules to be a list or tuple of non-empty strings
